g.text: Qwen3.8-27B · throughput vs full HTTP latency
M5 Ultra 256 GiB · identical NVFP4 weights / D prompts · normal EOS, cap 512 · formal observers OFF
14 measured points: native 1 process per C; oMLX and Lithos 3 processes per C. C1 is enlarged in each inset.
Process-metric medians · same 14 observations as v10
Qualification progress · no new performance points
Black outlines: nondominated observations only. 8 warm + 64 formal requests / process; server queueing included.
Separate cycles; native n=1/C, external engines n=3/C. No paired CI or interpolation. Lithos C8 uses FIFO GPU execution.
Qualification is separate from speed. GDN serving uses device bit/finite receipts; no offline recomputation of every success tensor.
Protocol/count gates do not establish cross-engine full-state or answer-quality equality. No E024 + GDN composition claim.
oMLX: documented post-run audit parser correction; original FAIL preserved. GLM has no qualified performance point.
